name: wave
guidelines: Greet someone with a friendly arm wave. Use it when a person arrives or greets the robot, or when asked to say hello or wave. The arm replays a fixed recorded motion and returns to rest, so keep the space in front of the robot clear and do not use it while the gripper is holding something.
guidelines_when_running: The wave is a fixed replay that finishes on its own in a few seconds. Let it complete rather than starting another arm skill on top of it.
